caption_L1: This line chart is titled Average annual wages in Portugal from 2000 to 2019 (in euros). The y-axis shows Average annual wages in euros as linear scale from 0 to 20,000 while the x-axis shows Year using linear scale with a minimum of 2000 and a maximum of 2015.
caption_L2L3: The average income in Portugal over 20 years, from 2000 to 2019, hasn't varied massively. The maximum variation seems to occur between 2011 and 2012. Nevertheless, average income in Portugal fluctuates between 17000 and 18500 a year.
